verdict.rationale: RUN documents a few inherently batch actions: AI-powered import of all employees' hours from an existing timesheet file, and automatic pay deposits into each employee's account on payday. It does not document a general bulk-edit or bulk-action capability across arbitrary records. Missing for 10: general multi-select bulk editing or actions across employee records, bulk operations exposed via API or AI tooling, documented limits or scale of batch actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Instantly import into RUN your employees’ hours from the timesheet file you already use today, thanks to the power of AI.
On payday, pay is automatically deposited in each employee’s account.
